# EigenScope Semantic Firewall — Antigravity Plugin & Enterprise IDE Fleet Pack

`@eigenscope/antigravity-plugin` packages the official EigenScope 4-channel semantic separation firewall, MCP server integration, lifecycle hooks, rules, and skill for **Antigravity IDE**, along with GitOps and MDM deployment templates for **Claude Code**, **Cursor**, **VS Code**, **Codex CLI**, **GitHub Actions**, **Jamf Pro (macOS)**, and **Microsoft Intune (Windows)**.

## Included Components

- [plugin.json](./plugin.json) — Antigravity plugin manifest (`eigenscope-firewall` v0.2.17).
- [hooks.json](./hooks.json) — Root-level lifecycle hooks (`SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`).
- [hooks/eigenscope_hook.mjs](./hooks/eigenscope_hook.mjs) — Zero-dependency Node.js (`>=20`) ESM hook runner implementing fail-closed strict/audit gating, `/v1/health` attestation, `/v1/decompose` inspection (`CODING_AGENT_FIREWALL`), immediate `/v1/vault/scrub` cleanup, and outbound vault-placeholder egress blocking.
- [mcp_config.json](./mcp_config.json) — Antigravity Stdio MCP registration for `npx -y @eigenscope/mcp-server --stdio`.
- [rules/AGENTS.md](./rules/AGENTS.md) — Always-on operational guardrails preserving zero-tag separation and the `decompose -> customer provider call -> rehydrate` product boundary.
- [skills/eigenscope-protection/SKILL.md](./skills/eigenscope-protection/SKILL.md) — Progressive-disclosure workflow skill covering coding prompts, untrusted tool/MCP quarantine, two-axis RAG gating, and deterministic vault restoration.
- [enterprise/README-IDE-FLEET.md](./enterprise/README-IDE-FLEET.md) — Enterprise fleet templates for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Actions, Jamf Pro, and Intune.

## Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ORTHOCORE_BASE_URL` | `https://eigenscope.guardianai.network` | Authority origin (`https://` or explicit loopback `http://127.0.0.1` / `localhost`). |
| `ORTHOCORE_API_KEY` | unset | Tenant bearer token (or stored in `0600` `~/.config/eigenscope/credentials.json`). |
| `EIGENSCOPE_HOOK_MODE` | `audit` | `audit` (warn without locking out unconfigured devs), `strict` (fail-closed termination on secrets, `422`, or missing/unreachable authority), or `off`. |
| `EIGENSCOPE_HOOK_STRICT_TOOL_SCAN` | `false` | Set `true` to also scan outbound tool arguments via `/v1/decompose` in `PreToolUse`. |
| `EIGENSCOPE_KEEP_VAULT_TICKET` | `false` | Set `true` to retain `vault_ticket` across turns instead of scrubbing immediately after `PreInvocation`. |

## Quick Verification

Pipe a sample hook event directly to [hooks/eigenscope_hook.mjs](./hooks/eigenscope_hook.mjs):

```sh
printf '{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","toolCall":{"id":"t1","name":"read_file","args":{}}}' | node ./hooks/eigenscope_hook.mjs
```
